record.scope: Offline operator replay on original reference operands. Chained replay reuses its own previous state only; earlier native model activations are not captured by this diagnostic. Endpoint equality is reported separately.

record.model: D:\models\Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; independent GB10 operator operands, no model load

record.scope: Offline recurrence only: one independently measured GPU projection error replaces that diagnostic operand. Original reference activations and oracle files remain unchanged; no reference activation is supplied to model inference.

record.method: Float64 power iteration estimates the actual head13 incoming-state delta direction. Each original key direction is propagated through subsequent original beta/key updates; scalar decay is omitted because only direction is compared. Key normalization uses float64 arithmetic, so this is geometric localization, not a numerical replay or proof of a changed gate.

candidate.repair_scope: K2048,32-row packed gate projections only. Non-midpoints keep original output; exact FP32/BF16 midpoint cases use compensated double accumulation to determine the side before final BF16 rounding. No layer/head/position/token/reference selectors.

public_evidence_view.scope: Public view with personal home prefixes replaced in text and object keys. Embedded hashes identify unmodified original artifacts. Commands containing aliases require local path substitution.
